name: Kirishima Shizuku
source:
A very traditional Japanese girl in her third year of high school. Having traits of a Yamato nadeshiko, she is very skilled at calligraphy and flower arrangement. She falls in love with [url=/c7197]Eris[/url] after meeting her.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sono_Hanabira_ni_Kuchizuke_o]Wikipedia[/url]]
